title: Tutor student: the Nguyen family skips Thursday's session ($42 she won't earn this week); bills are covered and the free hour changes nothing, so Dev stays quiet

changes.subject: Can we skip this Thursday? Mia has a recital

best_fix.what: Nothing. If she opens Today, the Thursday 4:30 to 5:30 PM tutoring block is simply gone from her calendar (removed with the family's email on Tuesday night). Dev does not send a push, does not offer to refill the hour, and does not predict next week's tutoring income.
best_fix.why: Tutoring is paid per session, so a skipped session is $42 not earned, not a bill missed. Her checking shows $610.00 available against $98.00 of bills in the next 10 days (phone $30 Nov 14, AI app $20 Nov 16, car insurance $48 Nov 21); Alvarez paid $45 on Nov 10 and Brandt's $40 for this week is open and not yet due (Nov 13). Nothing collides and nothing is at risk.

must_not: send a push or card about the skipped session or the $42
warn that her income is down or predict what next week's tutoring will pay
count the open $40 Brandt invoice (due Nov 13) as money she has
offer to fill the freed Thursday 4:30 PM hour with a study block
suggest she message the Nguyen family to reschedule, or write to them
touch her savings ($243.00 is her emergency fund)
assumptions: Families pay by Zelle at about the time of each session, $45, $40 and $42 a session; the simulator invoices on the session day.
One skipped session is common for a tutor (recitals, sick kids); a pattern of three or more skips in a month would be a different case.
Her checking balance at 8 PM Wednesday is $610.00 available with 4 small card charges pending.
The Nguyen family's email is shown as metadata only: sender and subject.

tempting.suggestion: offer to fill the freed Thursday 4:30 PM hour with a study block
tempting.why_wrong: her study windows are Monday, Wednesday and Friday afternoons (2:00 to 4:45 PM); Thursday is not a study day
